e.title: insurance-recurrent
e.summary: 共享 frailty 复发索赔（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：保单内索赔复发、个体风险分层
e.summary_en: Shared frailty recurrent claims (burning-cost, PyPI 0.1.0): within-policyholder claim recurrence, individual risk stratification
e.summary_hk: 共享 frailty 復發索賠（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：保單內索賠復發、個體風險分層
e.body: insurance-recurrent（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）用共享 frailty 模型处理保单内索赔复发：同一保单多次索赔的依赖结构、个体风险分层（frailty = 不可观测的个体风险因子）。对 RIAA：索赔复发意味着同一保单的多次索赔不独立——忽略复发的频率模型低估方差；frailty 模型是复发事件的标准工具（与 [[insurance-poisson-mixture-nn]] 的异质性视角互补）；与 [[insurance-survival]]、[[insurance-competing-risks]] 构成生存分析家族；适合车险/健康险的个体风险建模。
e.body_en: insurance-recurrent (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.0) uses shared frailty models for within-policyholder claim recurrence: dependence structure across repeated claims of one policy, individual risk stratification (frailty = unobservable individual risk factor). For RIAA: claim recurrence means a policy's multiple claims are not independent — frequency models ignoring recurrence understate variance; frailty models are the standard tool for recurrent events (complementing the heterogeneity view of [[insurance-poisson-mixture-nn]]); with [[insurance-survival]] and [[insurance-competing-risks]] it forms the survival family; suits individual risk modelling in motor/health.
e.body_hk: insurance-recurrent（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）用共享 frailty 模型處理保單內索賠復發：同一保單多次索賠的依賴結構、個體風險分層（frailty = 不可觀測的個體風險因子）。對 RIAA：索賠復發意味著同一保單的多次索賠不獨立——忽略復發的頻率模型低估方差；frailty 模型是復發事件的標準工具（與 [[insurance-poisson-mixture-nn]] 的異質性視角互補）；與 [[insurance-survival]]、[[insurance-competing-risks]] 構成生存分析家族；適合車險/健康險的個體風險建模。
